### R

```{r}
#| label: concave-hessian-r
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of f(x) = 1 - x1^2 - x2^2 for x1 and x2 from -1.5 to 1.5,
#|   a dome with its highest point, height 1, at the origin, falling off
#|   equally in every direction.
cc_x_cc <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 41)
cc_square_cc <- cc_x_cc^2
cc_sum_cc <- outer(cc_square_cc, cc_square_cc, "+")
cc_dome_cc <- 1 - cc_sum_cc
cc_stops_cc <- c(0, 1)
cc_blue_cols_cc <- c("#CCE0F0", "#0072B2")
cc_blue_cc <- list(cc_stops_cc, cc_blue_cols_cc)
cc_eye_cc <- list(x = 1.6, y = -1.6, z = 0.9)
cc_camera_cc <- list(eye = cc_eye_cc)
cc_xaxis_cc <- list(title = "x1")
cc_yaxis_cc <- list(title = "x2")
cc_zaxis_cc <- list(title = "f(x)")
cc_scene_cc <- list(
  xaxis = cc_xaxis_cc,
  yaxis = cc_yaxis_cc,
  zaxis = cc_zaxis_cc,
  camera = cc_camera_cc
)
plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = cc_x_cc,
    y = cc_x_cc,
    z = cc_dome_cc,
    colorscale = cc_blue_cc,
    showscale = FALSE
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(scene = cc_scene_cc)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(knitr::is_html_output())
#| results: asis

  "*(This 3D surface is interactive; see the HTML or slide version",

)
```

### Python

```{python}
#| label: concave-hessian-python
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of f(x) = 1 - x1^2 - x2^2 for x1 and x2 from -1.5 to 1.5,
#|   a dome with its highest point, height 1, at the origin, falling off
#|   equally in every direction.
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-width: 6
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

cc_x1_py, cc_x2_py = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(-1.5, 1.5, 41),
                                 np.linspace(-1.5, 1.5, 41))
cc_dome_py = 1 - cc_x1_py**2 - cc_x2_py**2
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4.5))
ax = fig.add_subplot(projection="3d")
ax.plot_surface(cc_x1_py, cc_x2_py, cc_dome_py, color="#0072B2", alpha=0.7)
ax.set_xlabel("x1")
ax.set_ylabel("x2")
ax.set_zlabel("f(x)")
plt.show();
```

:::

The [graph](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-graph) of the [strictly concave function](#def-strictly-concave) $f(\vx) = 1 - x_1^2 - x_2^2$ of @exm-concave-hessian,
a dome with its highest point at $\vzero$.

:::
